short_description: Multiple-award contract for maintenance, repair, minor construction, and occasional design-build services.
project_scope: Advance notice for a multiple-award task order contract at Tobyhanna Army Depot covering basic facility maintenance, repair, and minor construction work over five years. Typical tasks may include interior and exterior renovations; heating and air-conditioning; HVAC controls; plumbing; fire suppression; electrical and lighting; fire and intrusion alarms; communications; limited utilities; site work; landscaping; fencing; masonry; roofing; concrete; asphalt paving; storm drainage; limited environmental remediation; surveys; studies; design-build; and construction of new facilities. No specific building sizes, spans, or gross floor areas are stated.
services: General building construction services with possible design-build components; architecture services; interior design/space planning; landscape architecture; programming; rehabilitation and refurbishment; civil engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Broad MATOC/framework-type opportunity without a defined technically demanding structure.
- Focus is mainly general building maintenance, repair, refurbishment, and minor construction.
- Includes many trades and MEP-related works, which are generally not core sbp targets.
- Possible design-build and civil engineering components are mentioned, but no specific bridge, long-span roof, tower, or special structure is identified.
- Military depot context and absence of clear structural ambition reduce strategic fit.
construction_cost_explanation: Estimated from the tender documents: total construction cost is stated as $100.0M-$250.0M; midpoint used = 175000000 USD. The comments also mention a contract value of $30M, but the IMS field lists total construction cost separately at $100.0M-$250.0M.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning fee is stated. This is a MATOC/sources sought notice for general construction, repair, maintenance, and occasional design-build services. Useful fee indicators: five-year duration, broad multi-trade scope, possible architecture/civil/design-build tasks, and a stated total construction cost range of 100000000 to 250000000 USD, but no reliable sbp-specific fee can be derived.
references_qualifications: Potential small business concerns should be able to provide basic facility maintenance, repair, and minor construction work. The notice indicates capability across multiple trades and possible design-build services. No detailed minimum reference counts or specific qualification thresholds are stated.
contracting_authority: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Tobyhanna Army Depot project. Agency contact: Justin Marino, (570) 615-7106, justin.m.marino2.civ@army.mil. Additional contact listed: Jonathan P. Bradshaw, jonathan.p.bradshaw@usace.army.mil. Website: https://sam.gov/opp/25539a2dcba34fb0a9d00d0a2588f1e0/view
notes: Sources sought / advance notice, not a final solicitation. Solicitation number noted as MATOC2026RFI; project number TYADFY24MATOC. Contract duration stated as five years. The notice says the solicitation has been reissued. This is a military facility MATOC and may function as a framework-style procurement with task orders rather than a single defined project.
